node.title: Re: capturing stdout of pipe
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
What is the correct way to do this with pipes.

It's an FAQ! [https://perldoc.perl.org/perlfaq8.html#How-can-I-open-a-pipe-both-to-and-from-a-command%3f|How can I open a pipe both to and from a command?]

However, in the specific case of curl, my preferred answer is: don't shell out in the first place but use a module instead. eg: [metamod://LWP::UserAgent], [metamod://LWP::Simple], [metamod://HTTP::Tiny], [metamod://Furl], [metamod://Net::Curl::Easy], etc., etc.
